newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Prudential America to boost Asian property deals.
newsitem.headline: Prudential America to boost Asian property deals.

text.p: Prudential Insurance Company of America said on Thursday it was stepping up investment activity in Asia and appointing a new managing director to its Singapore joint venture investment management firm.

Prudential said in a statement a new investment would boost to US$150 million its current US$105 million commitment in an institutional Asian real estate investment fund, South East Asia Property Company (SEAPC).
No details of the venture were disclosed by Prudential.
A spokesman said the deal was part of a planned increase to US$300 million in its investment in SEAPC by 1998.
SEAPC is Prudential's first Southeast Asian property investment vehicle. It has backed five projects so far in Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand.
It said Prudential was now exploring new investment opportunities in other Asian nations, including China.

SEAPC is managed by by GRA (Singapore), a joint venture between Prudential of America and Jones Lang Wootton International. Prudential said it had assigned Loh Chin Hua to the post of managing director effective from November 1.
Prudential of America is not related to London-listed Prudential Corp Plc.
